was: Idaho Power recreation park on the Snake River below Oxbow Dam on OR-86 near Oxbow/Halfway (Hells Canyon); 62 sites incl RV sites with water + 20/30-amp electric, tent sites, showers, dump, boat launch; 14-day limit. Idaho Power is an investor-owned utility -> private. --Claude
note: Idaho Power park on 12 acres of lawn and trees near the town of Oxbow, on Hells Canyon Road and Oregon Highway 86: 59 RV sites with water and 30-amp power, 10 tent sites with shared water, showers, a dump station, fire rings and an EV charger.  The boat launch is half a mile downstream on Homestead Road.  Day use is free; 14 nights at most.  Utility-run, so ownership is private. --Claude

booking.note: Book by midnight Mountain Time the day before; same-day online bookings aren't taken. Unreserved sites go to campers who arrive without a booking.

was: Mohave County park in the pine/oak Hualapai Mountains ~14 mi SE of Kingman (high elevation ~6500 ft). RV campground (Pioneer) with full hookups (electric/water/sewer), dump station, restrooms, drinking water; separate dry-camping sites FCFS. RV sites $45/night, reservation-only via CampLife/Mohave County. Open ~May 1-Oct 31. --Claude
note: Mohave County park in the pine country of the Hualapai Mountains, about 14 miles southeast of Kingman, at 4,984 to 8,417 ft: the Elk Ridge (rigs to 60 ft) and Pioneer (to 30 ft) RV campgrounds with full hookups, first-come dry sites, cabins, group areas and hiking and ATV trails.  The RV campgrounds are open May 1 to October 31 and booked ahead. --Claude

was: Long-running hilltop campground at 574 Campground Rd, one mile from I-77 exit 8 at Fancy Gap and about half a mile off the Blue Ridge Parkway; entrance is off US-52 just past the Dollar General, up a steep lane. Operator lists 72 full-hookup sites with large pull-thrus plus 26 tent sites, 6 of them with water and electric; bath house with hot showers, laundry, playground, social hall with kitchen, dump station, firewood, free Wi-Fi. Campendium reports sites to 60 ft and a dated July 2025 stay on a gravel pull-thru full-hookup site. RV Life 4.5*/$$ ~$40/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
